changes: Implemented Lattice unattended host-to-host autopilot execution modes: conservative manual-merge automation, authority-verified server-receipt-gated integration, bounded full-autopilot policy, host-native delegation contracts, dispatch/autopilot two-policy linkage, strict CLI ownership gates, authority receipt hardening, cancel/resume/status/review evidence preservation, and updated docs/tests.
usage: Use lattice dispatch_policy_create to define allowed host/scope/launcher policy, lattice autopilot_policy_create to bind an autopilot mode to that dispatch policy, then run lattice autopilot_run, autopilot_status, autopilot_watch, autopilot_review, autopilot_cancel, or autopilot_resume with the returned runId. Conservative mode gives a manual merge plan; authority-verified and full-autopilot remain gated by server receipt and bounded policy.
expectedOutcome: A user can ask Lattice to coordinate unattended host-to-host development while preserving proof boundaries: no fake production authority, no unchecked main merge, clear runId status/review/cancel/resume behavior, and verifiable CLI transcripts.
actualTranscript: On HEAD 4f9e825, build passed; autopilot-run-smoke, dispatch-run-smoke, unattended-dispatch-smoke, command-ownership-contract, flow-stability-smoke, remote-push-approval-smoke, done-preflight-smoke all passed; lattice validate returned allPass=true with 33/33 verification intents covered; koala-codex verify passed 7/8 with only the expected global fallback heartbeat advisory.
outcomeDiff: No acceptance gap remains. The actual behavior matches the expected unattended development model while intentionally keeping conservative merge manual and production authority server-receipt-gated.
limitations: Full production autopilot remains intentionally bounded and authority-gated. Conservative mode never auto-merges. Local diagnostic receipts cannot prove productionDone or receiptVerified. Global Codex fallback heartbeat is advisory when it resolves to main rather than the story worktree.
pitfalls: Main introduced a cleanup commit that stops tracking most .koala local state, so the merge conflict had to be resolved by accepting the cleanup while preserving B-47cd local story state for gate commands. One npm script name for done-preflight was absent, so the equivalent dist task was run directly and passed.
